sources.summary: Dezeen School Shows: a centre dedicated to nuclear learning set within the historic landscape of Stowe, UK, is among the projects by students at Cardiff University. Also included is an ecology centre designed around the transparency of its AI use, and a community-driven recycling centre that gives unwanted items a second life.
